source: ZXMATH0000XZ = batch size;ZXMATH0001XZ = sequence length;ZXMATH0002XZ = model/residual width;ZXMATH0003XZ = query-head count;ZXMATH0004XZ = key/value-head count;ZXMATH0005XZ = head dimension;ZXMATH0006XZ = feed-forward intermediate width. Unless stated otherwise, tensor shapes are logical shapes rather than a required physical memory layout.
zh: ZXMATH0000XZ = 批量大小；ZXMATH0001XZ = 序列长度；ZXMATH0002XZ = 模型/剩余宽度；ZXMATH0003XZ = 查询头计数；ZXMATH0004XZ = 键/值头计数；ZXMATH0005XZ = 头尺寸；ZXMATH0006XZ = 前馈中间宽度。除非另有说明，张量形状是逻辑形状而不是所需的物理内存布局。
